summary: SSE stream freezes; request never finishes for Northwind Health
description:
Issue summary: Customer on Redwood Private reports streaming responses intermittently freeze. They get partial output then nothing; no error; client socket stays open.

Impact: Clinical note drafting workflow blocks; users refresh and create duplicate notes.

Environment: Redwood Private (Kubernetes), customer ingress is NGINX, OpenAI-compatible SSE.

Customer observations: Happens more often when their ingress has HTTP/2 enabled; curl sometimes works; browser EventSource often hangs.

Requested: Confirmation whether Redwood supports HTTP/2 for SSE end-to-end and whether we have recommended NGINX settings.
comments: Vanessa Ortiz (Support): Looping in Private Deployments. Customer says   stream  stops (their words: 'freezes').
Rohan Mehta (Private Deployments): For NGINX, recommend proxy_buffering off and increase proxy_read_timeout for SSE. Also ensure chunked transfer is not buffered.
Elliot Price (Platform): Similar to SUP-1842; if no tokens are emitted for a while, some proxies time out. Heartbeat fix is in hosted; we need to confirm private version.
Rohan Mehta (Private Deployments): Customer on Private v1.8.2. Heartbeat landed in v1.8.4. Proposed: upgrade or backport.
Vanessa Ortiz (Support): Customer upgraded to v1.8.4 and applied NGINX settings; reports no more freezes over 24h. Closing.
resolution: Resolved via upgrade to Redwood Private v1.8.4 (includes SSE heartbeat) and recommended NGINX ingress settings (disable buffering, extend read timeout).
